# kube-dump profile format

A profile first selects the Kubernetes resources that may be captured and then applies ordered rules to matching objects. Use shell-style globs and a leading `!` in namespace, name, and resource selections to express compact exclusions. Use `NotIn` and `DoesNotExist` for negative label and annotation requirements. Built-in profiles are suitable starting points; copy one to a global profile before editing it. Runtime flags can narrow selection and configure encryption without changing the profile file.

## ImageSelectionSpec

ImageSelectionSpec selects image references from Pods by namespace, name,
labels, annotations, owners, and image reference.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |

| Properties | 7 |

### ImageSelectionSpec.namespaces

Key: `namespaces`

Path: [`images`](#profileimagepolicy).[`selection`](#imagepolicyimageselectionspec).`namespaces`

Namespaces limits objects to namespace names matching shell-style globs. A
leading `!` excludes matching namespaces; an empty list matches every namespace.
Quote values beginning with `!` in YAML because `!` otherwise starts a YAML tag.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items type | `string` |
| Items examples | `production`, `!kube-*` |
| Items constraints | `minLength=1`; `maxLength=128` |
| Constraints | `maxItems=256`; `uniqueItems=true` |

### ImageSelectionSpec.names

Key: `names`

Path: [`images`](#profileimagepolicy).[`selection`](#imagepolicyimageselectionspec).`names`

Names limits objects to names matching shell-style globs. A leading `!` excludes
matching names; an empty list matches every name. Quote values beginning with
`!` in YAML because `!` otherwise starts a YAML tag.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items type | `string` |
| Items examples | `api-*`, `!api-temporary-*` |

### ImageSelectionSpec.OwnerSelectionSpec

Key: `owners`

Path: [`images`](#profileimagepolicy).[`selection`](#imagepolicyimageselectionspec).`owners`

Owners selects objects in the ownerReference chain of a selected Pod. A Pod is
included only when at least one owner matches all configured owner filters. Use
Resources to distinguish Deployments, DaemonSets, StatefulSets, Jobs, and other
Kubernetes owner objects.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required | no |
| Reference | [`OwnerSelectionSpec`](#ownerselectionspec) (`#/$defs/OwnerSelectionSpec`) |

| Required | no |

| Items enum | `container`, `initContainer` |
| Items examples | `container`, `initContainer` |
| Constraints | `maxItems=2`; `uniqueItems=true` |

## ImageReferenceSpec

ImageReferenceSpec matches an image reference without conflating repository
selection with tag selection.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 3 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### ImageReferenceSpec.registry

Key: `registry`

Path: [`images`](#profileimagepolicy).[`selection`](#imagepolicyimageselectionspec).[`references`](#imageselectionspecreferences).`[]`.`registry`

Registry is the registry host glob, for example docker.io or ghcr.io.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | yes |
| Examples | `docker.io` |
| Constraints | `minLength=1`; `maxLength=253` |

### ImageReferenceSpec.repository

Key: `repository`

Path: [`images`](#profileimagepolicy).[`selection`](#imagepolicyimageselectionspec).[`references`](#imageselectionspecreferences).`[]`.`repository`

Repository is the repository path glob without the registry or tag.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | yes |
| Examples | `library/*` |
| Constraints | `minLength=1`; `maxLength=512` |

### ImageReferenceSpec.tags

Key: `tags`

Path: [`images`](#profileimagepolicy).[`selection`](#imagepolicyimageselectionspec).[`references`](#imageselectionspecreferences).`[]`.`tags`

Tags accepts image tags matching at least one shell-style glob pattern. An empty
list accepts tagged and digest-pinned references.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items type | `string` |
| Items examples | `MR-*`, `*-rc.*` |
| Items constraints | `minLength=1`; `maxLength=128` |
| Constraints | `maxItems=64`; `uniqueItems=true` |

## Example yaml document

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woozymasta/kube-dump/HEAD/pkg/profile/schema/profile.schema.json

apiVersion: kube-dump/v2
kind: Profile
metadata:
  name: clean-export
  description: Clean export suitable for sharing or redeployment
resources:
  omitEmpty: false
  selection:
    resources:
      - core/v1/configmaps
      - '!core/v1/configmaps:kube-root-ca.crt'
    namespaces:
      - production
      - '!kube-*'
    names:
      - api-*
      - '!api-temporary-*'
    labelSelector:
      matchLabels: {}
      matchExpressions:
        - key: environment
          operator: In
          values:
            - prod
    annotationSelector:
      matchLabels: {}
      matchExpressions:
        - key: environment
          operator: In
          values:
            - prod
  rules:
    - name: remove-runtime-metadata
      match:
        resources:
          - core/v1/secrets
          - apps/v1/deployments:api
        namespaces:
          - production
          - '!kube-*'
        names:
          - api-*
          - '!api-temporary-*'
        labelSelector:
          matchLabels: {}
          matchExpressions:
            - key: environment
              operator: In
              values:
                - prod
        annotationSelector:
          matchLabels: {}
          matchExpressions:
            - key: environment
              operator: In
              values:
                - prod
      remove:
        - .metadata.creationTimestamp
      encrypt:
        - .data.*
pvc:
  selection:
    namespaces:
      - production
      - '!kube-*'
    names:
      - api-*
      - '!api-temporary-*'
    labelSelector:
      matchLabels: {}
      matchExpressions:
        - key: environment
          operator: In
          values:
            - prod
    annotationSelector:
      matchLabels: {}
      matchExpressions:
        - key: environment
          operator: In
          values:
            - prod
images:
  selection:
    namespaces:
      - production
      - '!kube-*'
    names:
      - api-*
      - '!api-temporary-*'
    owners:
      resources:
        - apps/v1/deployments
      namespaces:
        - production
        - '!kube-*'
      names:
        - api-*
        - '!api-temporary-*'
      labelSelector:
        matchLabels: {}
        matchExpressions:
          - key: environment
            operator: In
            values:
              - prod
      annotationSelector:
        matchLabels: {}
        matchExpressions:
          - key: environment
            operator: In
            values:
              - prod
    containerTypes:
      - container
      - initContainer
    labelSelector:
      matchLabels: {}
      matchExpressions:
        - key: environment
          operator: In
          values:
            - prod
    annotationSelector:
      matchLabels: {}
      matchExpressions:
        - key: environment
          operator: In
          values:
            - prod
    references:
      - registry: docker.io
        repository: library/*
        tags:
          - MR-*
          - '*-rc.*'
```
